description: The help line `pardner bridge reconcile --config PATH --delivery ID --decision accepted|retry --evidence TEXT [--turn-id ID]` omits --token-file, but a client bridge's reconcile fails without it: `INVALID_ARGUMENT: Bridge configuration requires replicaId`. The story's own command (copied from the help) fails the same way.
expected: Help lists `[--token-file FILE]` for reconcile, and the missing-flag error says to supply it.
actual: Help omits it; error mentions an internal replicaId.
suggested_fix: Add [--token-file FILE] to the reconcile help line and replace the replicaId message with a --token-file hint.

description: Reconciling a delivery ID that does not exist returns `INVALID_BRIDGE_STATE: Only uncertain dispatches can be reconciled`, implying the row exists in a different state.
expected: `NOT_FOUND: No delivery dlv-nope in this bridge inbox`.
actual: State error for a missing row.
suggested_fix: Check existence before state in reconcile.
